SELECT HR.EMPID EMPID, HR.CPNY_ID CPNY, HR.POSITION_NO , HR.DUTY_NO DUTY_NAME, get_codename_by_codeno(HR.POST_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST, get_codename_by_codeno(HR.POST_GRADE_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POST_GRADE, HR.PERSON_ID PERSON_ID, HR.LOCAL_NAME LOCAL_NAME, get_codename_by_codeno(HR.POSITION_NO,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) POSITION , HR.DEPTNO DEPTNO, HRD.CONTENT DEPT_NAME, SY.CONTENT EMP_TYPE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(HR.EMP_OFFICE,#interLanguage:VARCHAR#) EMP_OFFICE_NAME FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HR, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HRD, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY WHERE HR.DEPTNO = HRD.DEPTNO(+) AND HR.EMP_TYPE_CODE = SY.NO(+) AND SY.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HRD.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR#
(HR.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR HR.EMPID LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%')
HR.EMP_TYPE_CODE = #EMP_TYPE:VARCHAR#
HR.EMP_OFFICE = #EMP_OFFICE_NAME:VARCHAR#
HR.DEPTNO IN ( select sud.deptno from sy_user_dept sud, (SELECT DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT START WITH DEPTNO = #DEPTNO# CONNECT BY PRIOR DEPTNO=PARENT_DEPT_NO) DEPT where sud.deptno = DEPT.deptno AND sud.user_no=#userNo:VARCHAR# )
HR.POSITION_NO = #POSITION:VARCHAR#
HR.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY HR.DEPTNO,HR.EMPID
